summary: Anonymous profile privacy + registered-user badge card verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass on public prod URL. GET /api/users/{anon} returns EXACTLY {user_id, nickname, auth_provider:'anonymous', is_anonymous:true} with no photos/bio/social_links/badge/votes/email/primary_photo_id leaked. GET /api/users/{anon}/history returns {history:[], is_anonymous:true} both before and after the anon user casts a vote via POST /api/feuds/{id}/vote (also validated with ?filter=all|majority|minority — none bypass the guard). Regression: GET /api/users/user_34c2f036bb2e still returns full payload with new fields auth_provider='email' and is_anonymous=false, plus badge{unlocked:true, type:'bastian_contrario', majority:5, minority:7}; history non-empty and does NOT include is_anonymous key. 404 preserved for missing user. Frontend (390x844 web): (a) /user/<anon_id> renders public-user-screen + public-anonymous card with glasses-outline in dark circle, 'UTENTE ANONIMO' title, @nickname, and full hint text 'Gli utenti anonimi non condividono foto, storico voti, spille o profilo pubblico.' — public-history-section count=0, public-badge-* count=0, zero runtime crash / undefined errors. (b) Registered user with total_votes<10 (user_b96abe2529c8): public-anonymous absent, public-history-section visible, public-badge-* absent. (c) Registered bastian_contrario (user_34c2f036bb2e): public-badge-bastian_contrario visible with the exact copy 'SPILLA / BASTIAN CONTRARIO / 5 maggioranza · 7 minoranza' on red brand card, public-badge-buon_senso NOT rendered, bio ('Bio test') and history section still render. (d) Tapping first history item (public-history-feud_d3409f4f26ba) navigates to /feud/feud_d3409f4f26ba — regression intact even though the feud returned 410 (expired). No React Native red screen, no deprecated packages touched in these files, no testID gaps.
